name: Making Repairs
summary: A supply shortage at a fortress far from the Undercity has left its defenders short of building materials. You are asked to search Shadowvale for lumber that can help restore it.

sections.title: Supplies at Shadowvale
sections.body: The ruined village of Shadowvale lies in the Whispering Forest, southwest of the fortress. You are sent to search an old root cellar in one of its buildings for usable materials. The fortress is difficult to supply at this distance from settled lands, and its repairs depend on what can be found there.

faq.answer: The fortress needs materials to help restore it, and its distance from the Undercity makes supplies difficult to bring in.
Shadowvale is a ruined village in the Whispering Forest, southwest of the fortress.

faq.q: Where might usable materials be found?
faq.answer: One of Shadowvale's buildings has an old root cellar where usable materials may be stored.

faq.q: What is the fortress short of?
faq.answer: The fortress is short of building materials needed for its restoration.
